name: Office dog
description: Chunky golden office puppy with floppy ears and a tag on its collar; nodes Head and Tail

nodes.Head: look around: rotate about Y (three.js) at its origin (the neck)
nodes.Tail: wag: rotate about Y (three.js) at its origin (the tail root)

notes: Fur, FurLight and FurDark can be recoloured by name for other coats.
